name: Biddy Mannion

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Biddy Mannion is a human midwife from the Irish island of Inishshark. A fairy king and fairy queen carried her away to nurse their sick child. Biddy cared for the child until it grew better, and she served the fairies well. When she finally returned home, a glamour hid her absence, so her own family never knew she was gone.

okr.objective: Describe Biddy Mannion as a human midwife who nursed the child of the fairy royalty.
